name: 0.12mm Non-planar top @MINI 0.25
description: 0.12mm layers for Prusa MINI/MINI+ with a 0.25 mm nozzle (half the nozzle, as 0.20mm on 0.4: the stock 0.15mm layers needed 0.09mm curved shells, which the head's cone grazed), curved top shells; auto chooses the shell count (2 to 6) and pattern for each curved area, with ironing left off. Thin curved parts (up to 3 mm) print in curved layers throughout on meshes with holes; closed meshes keep planar interiors. Curved tops run at 150% of the top surface speed. Uses the shared prusa-mini head.
